prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1142; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the sideswipe collision you were involved in while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state where you were coming from and where you were headed when the collision happened.

A: I was driving home from work on the freeway. I had just moved from the right lane into the middle lane because traffic was slowing ahead of me.

Q: Did you check your mirrors and blind spot before changing lanes?

A: I checked my mirror, and I didn't see anyone right beside me. I glanced over my shoulder too, I think, but I'm not totally sure I looked long enough.

Q: What happened next?

A: The other car came up on my left side and clipped the rear quarter panel of my car. It pushed me toward the right and I had to correct the steering. My car spun a little but didn't roll over.

Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?

A: I felt fine at first, just shaken up. But within a few hours my neck was really stiff, and by the next morning my lower back was sore and I had trouble turning my head to the left.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next day. They diagnosed a neck strain and a lower back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to physical therapy. I've been going to therapy twice a week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm trying to get back to normal, and some days are harder than others. I want the claim handled fairly.

Q: Thank you. That concludes this recorded statement.
